apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Stop — chest tightness that builds with exertion and eases with rest is a cardiac red flag. I'm not programming threshold intervals or any harder running block around that. See a doctor before your next run.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

No. Exertional chest tightness that resolves with rest is a cardiac red flag regardless of how fit you feel otherwise — that pattern doesn't get trained through. I won't schedule intervals or any harder running work until a doctor has cleared you. Get it checked before your next run.
